name: grpc-go
title: gRPC Go Service
blurb: Protobuf-first Go service: buf for lint/build/codegen, bufconn in-process tests plus a real TCP dial, standard health service and reflection
default_description: A gRPC service in Go, generated from a protobuf contract.
next_steps: go mod download && buf lint && buf generate

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: go install github.com/bufbuild/buf/cmd/buf@v1.61.0 && go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.36.10 && go install google.golang.org/grpc/cmd/protoc-gen-go-grpc@v1.6.1

verify.name: generate
verify.cmd: export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH" && go mod download && buf lint && buf generate

verify.name: format
verify.cmd: unformatted=$(gofmt -l cmd internal); if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then echo "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi

verify.name: run
verify.cmd:
export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH"; go build -o bin/probe ./cmd/probe && go build -o bin/server ./cmd/{{ npm_name }} && PORT=50071 ./bin/server >.grpc.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do if ./bin/probe -addr 127.0.0.1:50071 >.probe.out 2>/dev/null; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .grpc.log .probe.out 2>/dev/null; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; ./bin/probe -addr 127.0.0.1:50071 -text 'a b
c
' >.probe2.out 2>&1; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; grep -q 'lines=1 words=2 bytes=12' .probe.out && grep -q 'lines=2 words=3 bytes=6' .probe2.out
